goal: Extract the duplicated opaque capability registry scaffolding from enrollment_authority.ts and authority_port.ts into one internal generic capability-registry factory while preserving both public constructor type shapes, domain-specific binding validation, registry-local branding, and single-use behavior, and reducing the combined adapter line count below 331 lines.

acceptance.assertion: A shared generic capability-registry factory exists at plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/capability_registry.ts and both createEnrollmentAuthorityRegistry() and createMutationAuthorityRegistry() use it without retaining separate WeakMap-backed registry scaffolding.

Enrollment and mutation registry behavior remains unchanged, including issue validation, expiry, complete binding mismatch rejection, opaque and cross-registry recognition, non-consuming inspect, and irreversible single-use consume semantics.

The existing exported constructor and registry type shapes remain compatible with all current Kernel, Pi extension, and test fixture callers, and the shared factory remains internal to runtime/kernel.

The combined line count of enrollment_authority.ts and authority_port.ts is less than 332 lines after extraction, while enrollment-specific validation and mutation-specific validation including nullable findings_digest and action digest hashing remain in their respective modules.
